_about: SSO string Performance patches: the level of a note reached by a legato transition against the interval it comes from and its pitch, and of the same note reached by an attack. tools/soundlibraries/transition_level_scan.py (its header has the method). Measured 2026-10-12 on the Windows test VM: kthost (offline VST 3 host, C:\claude\kt), Kontakt 8 + SSO, each patch from MuseScore's resaved setup (library defaults), 44.1 kHz. Perceived loudness (tools/playbackverify/loudness.py, ~dB). Per patch / condition (S64: notes 136 ms at CC1 64; L64: 600 ms, CC1 64; S32 / S112: 136 ms at CC1 32 / 112) / transition velocity (69 fingered, 93 bowed) / destination pitch / interval from the note before: median over takes of heard (mean from the arrival to the next note's), swell (sso_slur_swell.json's window), first (136.4 ms from the arrival), steady (long notes: median 0.3-0.6 s), their spread (max - min over takes), n takes; d<Measure><Ref>: minus the same destination's spiccato (112) / smooth (5) attack in the same condition; takes: heard per take. runs: the validation runs (_runs). Result: transition_level_scan.py's header; transition_levels_report.py prints it. Measurement only: the renderer does not read this file.

method.cells: w (spiccato 112) -> x (fingered 69) -> y (transition under test) -> z (fingered 69, 0.4 s); x = y - interval, w = x - 2 (x + 2 at the bottom), z = y + 2 (y - 2 at the top); the note before off 24 ms after the next note-on; attacks: y alone then z; 1 s silence; CC11 127
method.takes: A grid order, B reversed, C shuffled; separate renders

_runs: validation runs (transition_level_scan.py run_phrases): phrases of a spiccato note then four slurs of four 136 ms notes as MuseScore plays Whence (each slur's first note bowed 93 from the slur before, the rest fingered 69), CC1 64; Celli also Whence 12-TET bar 2 (49 then 51 52 51 49 x4, twice per take); per note (the first, the attack, null) heard (mean from its detected arrival to the next note's) and swell (sso_slur_swell.json's window: 136.4 ms from the note-on + the map's legatoDelay), per take
